statement: A sampled Fourier-family frame bound plus exterior squared tails supplies a replacement estimate for a normalized explicit-formula matrix truncation.
compatible_assumptions: Same fixed smooth window, Fourier convention,grid2pi/L, weight envelope and a>c as source.
already_proved: Unweighted Gram<=2piL I, weighted Gram O(BL), exterior mass O(BLlogL); E2 O(B²L²logL).
conjectural_part: Extension to weaker local weight assumptions and other explicit-formula matrices.
next_step: Derive weighted frame embedding under local L² control and test spike counterexamples.
potential_counterexamples: Dropping decay or uniform derivative norms can destroy integrability/scaling; no global boundedness of nu is assumed.
tests: Analytic proof plus three independent reconstructions; no numeric proof claim.
significance: Reusable alternate truncation proof; full source theorem not certified.
difficulty: elementary/moderate current lemma; high for arithmetic extensions

statement: General Li multiset criterion has an essential every-index quantifier that cannot be replaced by a finite prefix using only symmetry,orderone and smooth zero-count main terms.
compatible_assumptions: Real symmetric entire products,normalized nonzero at0,1,zeros in criticalstrip; paired product convergence. No arithmetic axioms.
already_proved: Explicit planted quartets preserve every prescribed finite positive prefix, including counting-matched baseline.
conjectural_part: Whether any effective additional arithmetic tail criterion suffices.
next_step: State exact arithmetic tail hypothesis and identify the step excluding quartet construction.
potential_counterexamples: Counting-matched off-line quartet is explicit negative control.
tests: Exact rational quartet witness and analytic baseline bound; highprecision sums supplementary only.
significance: Prevents generic finite-certificate overclaims; no RH theorem.
difficulty: elementary model; arithmetic task extremely high
